# WJ12 · Tổng quan AI

Group **WJ · Quản trị agent (Next.js)** · page · Next.js: **exists (design W2)** (`/admin/overview`) · account `owner`

## Purpose
Health and usage of the AI assistant at a glance: today's message, agent-turn and token counts, system status (uptime, accounts online, channels) and a usage chart for 7, 14 or 30 days.

## Agent and care context
- Token usage and traces can contain message text, so they are staff-only (permission `admin.usage`). Loading is the plain text "Đang tải..." and a failed load stays on it (no error text).

## Who may see it
- Account in this frame: `owner` (a mock account of `mock/auth.ts`; the back end decides the real matrix, the menu is a convenience).
- Gate: `admin.usage`.
- Roles that can open the page: owner, manager.
- Menu entry: "Tổng quan AI" in the section "Quản trị agent", shown when the role holds any of `admin.usage`.

## Key actions
- Segmented "Lượt dùng" / "Token"
- Select "7 ngày qua" / "14 ngày qua" / "30 ngày qua"
- Hover a bar for both numbers of the day (no click action)

## Business rules
- Patient safety is a policy profile, never a removed feature: `patient_channel` (the default: messages to patients go to the review queue and a person sends them; memory from patient content is off; image, video, document and web tools are off; a red flag goes to a doctor before any model call; personal data is masked before the model; identity of a Zalo user is confirmed before the assistant names a patient) and `staff_assistant` (internal, staff-only accounts). The profile is set per Zalo account and per agent, the stricter of the two applies (PLAN-AI01 section 5).
